name: mjr.sh
description: A simple URL shortener for manjaro friends.

scripts.build: bun run build:assets && bunx markdown-to-html-cli --style ./assets/style.css --output public/index.html
scripts.build:assets: rm -rf public && mkdir -p public/assets && cp assets/favicon.svg assets/style.css public/assets/
scripts.db:migrate: bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply urls --remote
scripts.dev: bun run build && bunx wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: bun run build && bunx wrangler deploy
